description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing bookings, including creating, retrieving, updating, canceling, and other operations related to bookings. It handles various endpoints for booking management, with detailed API documentation and security guards.

classes.name: BookingsController_2024_08_13
classes.description: NestJS controller handling booking-related API endpoints, including creation, retrieval, rescheduling, canceling, and other booking operations with security and API documentation.

methods.name: createBooking
methods.description: Creates a new booking, supporting regular, instant, and recurring bookings, and handles billing.

methods.name: getBookingBySeatUid
methods.description: Retrieves a booking by its seat UID.

methods.name: getBooking
methods.description: Retrieves a booking by its UID, which can be a normal, recurring, or recurrence UID.

methods.name: getBookingRecordings
methods.description: Fetches all recordings for a specific booking.

methods.name: getBookingTranscripts
methods.description: Fetches real-time transcript download links for a booking's Cal Video session.

methods.name: getBookings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bookings with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: rescheduleBooking
methods.description: Reschedules an existing booking or seated booking.

methods.name: cancelBooking
methods.description: Cancels a booking, including seated and recurring bookings.

methods.name: reassignBooking
methods.description: Reassigns a booking to an auto-selected or specific host.

methods.name: reassignBookingToUser
methods.description: Reassigns a booking to a specific user/host.

methods.name: getCalendarLinks
methods.description: Retrieves 'Add to Calendar' links for a booking.

methods.name: getBookingReferences
methods.description: Fetches booking references, available for SCALE plan.

methods.name: getVideoSessions
methods.description: Retrieves video meeting sessions for a booking, supported for Cal Video.
